correctness.rationale: The proof covers all m≥2 and fields: mixed length-three relations exclude scalar generator images, every derivation is a unique pair (P,Q), idempotence gives P²=P, L_PQ+QP=Q and 2P⊗P=0, yielding zero in odd/zero characteristic or projection fibers in characteristic two. An eigenspace count proves the exponent r³+3r(m−r)² and full rank r+2r(m−r); automorphism shears remove Q, giving exactly m+1 classes. Smooth reduced components follow as vector bundles over projection varieties. Independent standard-library programs exhaustively tested every GF2 two-generator derivation and all GF2 two-generator automorphism orbits, plus finite-field linear equations for q=2,3,4 and m≤3. Finite tests are corroboration, not universal proof.

value.rationale: The first free noncommutative algebra with nonzero quadratic multiplication provides a natural test case for idempotent derivations and parity gradings. The result supplies a structural characteristic obstruction, complete classification under automorphisms, discrete full-rank spectrum, smooth moduli components and exact finite-field orbit sizes for unbounded generator count. These are linked intrinsic invariants, not an arbitrary finite slice.
